# Developer Tools APIs at Squarespace

 Last updated November 12, 2026 16:52

#### Overview of available developer APIs

The following is a list of Squarespace Developer Tools APIs. Squarespace will aim to keep this list up to date. Some of these Developer Tools are available for use by all developers, and some are invite-only. Use of our Developer Tools and participation in any Squarespace developer programs are subject to the [Squarespace Developer Terms](http://squarespace.com/developer-terms).

Each API contains multiple endpoints. Please see the applicable API documentation (e.g., [Reseller](http://reseller.squarespace.com), [Websites](http://developers.squarespace.com), [Acuity](http://developers.acuityscheduling.com)) for more details. If you have any questions, please [contact us](https://www.squarespace.com/contact).

- Acuity API (see [here](https://developers.acuityscheduling.com/reference/quick-start) for more information)
- Contacts API
- Discounts API
- Domains Search API
- Domains Management API
- Incoming Webhooks API
- Inventory API
- Orders API
- Products API
- Profiles API
- Reseller API
- Scripts API
- Transactions API
- UI Component Registrations API
- Webhook Subscriptions API

## Use the Squarespace MCP server to connect AI assistants

The Squarespace MCP server connects AI assistants, like Claude and ChatGPT, to Squarespace tools using Model Context Protocol (MCP). Tools are organized by product area, like domains and commerce, and we add new tools over time. Developers can find the current list of tools and setup steps in our[ MCP developer documentation](https://developers.squarespace.com/mcp/overview). If you use an AI assistant, you can also [connect Squarespace to it](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/49678454269197/) and use Squarespace tools, like domain search and store management, in the middle of any conversation.

## What terms apply when I use Squarespace developer tools?

The terms that apply depend on how you use our developer tools:

- If you’re a developer building with our APIs or MCP server to do things like add domain search to your product, create a product integration for your users who also use Squarespace, or otherwise taking part in a Squarespace developer program, our[ Developer Terms of Use](https://www.squarespace.com/developer-terms) cover your use case.
- If you’re [using Squarespace via an AI assistant](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/49678454269197/) to do things like search for a domain or manage your use of Squarespace, our[ Terms of Service](https://www.squarespace.com/terms-of-service) cover your use case.
